name: Steal ASMR!
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal ASMR!

Steal eggs, hatch rare ASMR squishies, and build a collection that squishes, crunches, and pays! 🤑

How to Play:
🥚 STEAL eggs and bring them back to your base
🐣 HATCH eggs to discover rare ASMR squishies
💰 EARN money from your ASMR collection
⬆️ UPGRADE your treadmill and base
🏃 TRAIN on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal other player's ASMRs!

🍀 Play with a friend for income!
👍 Like + join the group for 10,000 speed!

📱 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet
